strengths: The same project-owned module reads as an inset cross window in dark masonry and contemporary plaster without geometry-specific host hacks.
Deep reveals, projecting sill, cross mullions, physical glazing and visible room depth prevent a facade-card reading.
Three useful inspection angles retain the window silhouette and show angle-varying glazing response without clipped highlights.
limitations: The module has no operable sash, hinges, latch, fasteners, seals or weathering variants and is not accepted for hero close-ups.
The verification room is deliberately simple; campaign interiors must supply their own depth, dressing and motivated light.
Compatibility is currently limited to rectangular openings and wall thicknesses between 0.22 and 0.42 metres.
notes: Accepted for background and medium architectural use. Acceptance must independently prove that both host witnesses contain a real clear aperture rather than trusting the review or the persisted opening report.
